summary: Fractal web availability edits no longer overwrite a newer read with an older write answer

schema.detail: No database, claim or client API change.

compatibility.detail: Availability and note edits stay serialized. When a focus, visibility or reconnection read is requested while an edit is in flight, Settings reads availability again after the edit is answered and shows that read instead of the edit's answer; the editor stays pending until it lands.

recovery.detail: Returning to the page reads the current state.
